protocol.name: frozen-session-profiles-causal-post-search-replay
protocol.execution: closed M15 price-action signal; next-M15 bid/ask pending replay; SL-first ambiguity; spread stress x1.25
protocol.selection: profiles frozen from source report; same-timestamp priority fixed before outcome

limitations: This is a causal correction of the frozen development selection, not a fresh holdout and not a new parameter search.
Static profile priority resolves simultaneous signals without using their future outcome.
Only M15/H1 and R-based 1% compounding are used; broker margin, minimum distance/size, gaps, financing and rejections still require a separate frozen replay.
